comment: "I found the real-life scenarios and strategies to prevent medication errors the most interesting. They show how small steps can directly improve patient safety."
"This course made me realize that drug administration mistakes can happen at any second, and thats why it is Important to double check and follow all the safety rules."
"I found it interesting the way that medication being checked is different from working on the floor as a nurse."
"I appreciated the content, such as learning about how facilities buy drugs through different routes while experiencing shortages."
"I found it most interesting learning about the potential things that could cause a medication error."
"I learned how anesthesiologists don't have as many safety nets as those working post-op or bedside, which makes it easier for errors to occur during surgery."
"I enjoyed the videos in the course as they explained and laid out the information well."
"I found all of it interesting because this is all new information to me since I am a nursing student."
"I enjoyed the real-life scenarios that show how errors happen and how they can be prevented—these stories often help the concepts stick."
